articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Mexican Ninja – Official Demo Launch Teaser Trailer


Get ready to slice and dice through the neon-lit streets of Nuevo Tokyo as Mexican Ninja, a 2.5D arcade-action roguelike from Madbricks, throws you into the rollicking world of a masked hero on a mission. Master flashy combos, unlock powerful abilities and discover just how spicy life can get when you’re the only thing standing between chaos and order.
Landing soon on PC via Steam, the demo is already live for you to test your ninja mettle. Grab it now, dive in and see if you’ve got what it takes to become the ultimate Mexican Ninja!
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Mexican Ninja - Official Demo Launch Teaser Trailer

articles.description:

Best part? Kaiju No. 8 The Game is free-to-play on iOS, Android, and Steam, so you can dive in right now and unleash Hoshina’s full power on kaiju.

articles.title: IGN: Kaiju No. 8 The Game - Official Soshiro Hoshina Character Trailer

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
R.L. Stine’s Pumpkinhead is a new YA horror movie premiering October 17 on Tubi. When teenager Sam moves to Redhaven, his brother Finn suddenly vanishes—and worse, nobody (not even their mom) remembers he ever existed. With Halloween looming, Sam teams up with his pal Becka and the town’s oddball Rusty to break a sinister harvest curse before Finn is lost forever.
The film stars Bean Reid, Adeline Lo, Kevin McNulty, Bob Frazer, Matty Finochio and Seth Isaac Johnson. It’s written and directed by Jem Garrard, with an executive-producer lineup that includes James Mattagne, Joan Waricha, Harvey Kahn and Yvonne Bernard.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: R.L. Stine's Pumpkinhead - Official Trailer (2025)

articles.description:

Coming soon to PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X|S and PC (Steam, GoG & Epic Games Store).
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Liminal Point - Official Gameplay Trailer

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
Peacemaker Season 2 seems to have tumbled into a grim DCU spin on Earth-X—the Nazis-won World War II universe—but eagle-eyed fans spotted a throwaway Pokémon mention that doesn’t quite fit. That tiny nod might actually point to a completely different alternate reality where history took another dark turn.
So, have our reluctant heroes really landed in Earth-X, or is this a brand new “Allies-lost” universe? And if it is Earth-X, are we about to meet Uncle Sam and the Freedom Fighters? Drop your theories below!
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: What Pokemon Reveals About Peacemaker's Earth-X - IGN Daily Fix

IGN just released the Dark Ties combat gameplay trailer for Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties, the souped-up remake of Yakuza 3 alongside a standalone Dark Ties experience from Ryu Ga Gotoku Studio. You’ll get to see Yoshitaka Mine throw down in brutal close-quarters brawling.  
Mark your calendars for February 12—Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties lands on PS4, PS5, Xbox Series X|S, Nintendo Switch 2, and PC (Steam).
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: Yakuza Kiwami 3 & Dark Ties - Official Dark Ties Combat Gameplay Trailer

articles.author: Gaming News
articles.description:
John Candy: I Like Me streams October 10 on Amazon Prime Video. Directed by Colin Hanks, this documentary stitches together never-before-seen home videos and heartfelt interviews (Tom Hanks, Bill Murray, Steve Martin, Conan O’Brien and more) to explore the highs and lows of Candy’s life both on and off camera.
You’ll see the son, husband, father, friend and comedy icon behind classics like Planes, Trains and Automobiles tackling Hollywood pressure and personal demons—all while keeping that irrepressible sense of humor that made him one of the brightest stars of the ’70s, ’80s, and ’90s.
Watch on YouTube
articles.title: IGN: John Candy: I Like Me - Official Teaser Trailer (2025) Documentary

Everything Wrong With Dumb and Dumber In 18 Minutes Or Less is a tongue-in-cheek CinemaSins breakdown of the classic comedy’s endless pratfalls and occasional brilliance, all powered by a sponsorship from Trade (snag 50% off at drinktrade.com/sins). articles.author: Movie News
articles.description:
The Mummy 2017 was meant to launch Universal’s Dark Universe with a bang, but despite a nearly \$200 million budget, Tom Cruise lead, and cheeky promo cameos from Javier Bardem and Johnny Depp, it spectacularly bombed. In this Caravan of Garbage review, the hosts gleefully dissect all the marketing misfires, behind-the-scenes chaos, and colossal flops that turned the reboot into one of Hollywood’s biggest dumpster fires.
Hungry for more snark? Swing by bigsandwich.co for early videos and bonus podcasts, catch the Extended Audio Edition on YouTube, follow James and Maso on Twitter, or back the show on Patreon. There’s also merch, iTunes/direct podcast feeds, and a YouTube channel to keep your film-nerd fix fully loaded.
